hints.title: Think past the last step
hints.body: The finish line is position `n`, one place after the final step. The last move into that position started at step `n - 1` or step `n - 2`.

hints.title: Define the state
hints.body: Let `dp[i]` be the cheapest way to stand at position `i` without paying for a step at that position. Positions `0` and `1` are both free starting points, so `dp[0] = dp[1] = 0`.

hints.title: Pay only when leaving
hints.body: To reach position `i`, leave step `i - 1` after paying `cost[i - 1]`, or leave step `i - 2` after paying `cost[i - 2]`. Keep the cheaper total.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
twoBack = 0
oneBack = 0
for position from 2 to length(cost):
    current = min(oneBack + cost[position - 1],
                  twoBack + cost[position - 2])
    twoBack = oneBack
    oneBack = current
return oneBack
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
